title: Keep query/cost/retention/runtime admission distinct
resolution: Open prerequisite, not a decision: Execution project stays unconfigured; no private identity/job/billing-project data goes into public candidates. Obtain IAM, explicit cost and provider result-materialization authorization plus owned no-retention enforcement, finite bytes/output/time limits and Go/browser acceptance separately. Free tier is not admission. Blocking for these candidates before activation; does not reclose passed programme gates.
